decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed by filtering out non-speaker accessories (cases, chargers) and products with poor ratings or outdated technology (the 30-pin Bose dock). My consideration set focused on high-performing portable speakers. The JBL Go 3 and XENEO X21 are excellent budget options, while the JBL Pulse 4 is a high-end visual piece. The BOGASING M4 offers significant power for its price. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) because it represents a professional-grade, waterproof speaker with a proven sound signature at a price point that offers better value than buying new, making it the most balanced choice for performance and cost.
